description: This file contains utility functions for wrapping neural network modules within the PyTorch Distributed FSDP (Fully Sharded Data Parallel) framework. It includes functions for automatic module wrapping according to policies, validation of parameters, and traversal of module trees to manage distributed training setups.

methods.name: _auto_wrap( root_module: nn.Module, policy: Callable | _Policy, ignored_modules: set[nn.Module], ignored_params: set[nn.Parameter], root_kwargs: dict[str, Any], fsdp_fn: Callable, )
methods.description: Automatically wraps modules in a module tree according to a specified policy, supporting mixed precision management and nested wrapping validation.

methods.name: _check_nested_wrapping(root_module: nn.Module)
methods.description: Checks that modules in the tree are not already wrapped with FSDP to prevent nested wrapping conflicts.

methods.name: _warn_on_overridden_mixed_precision( overridden_module_classes: set[type[nn.Module]], )
methods.description: Issues a warning if modules are wrapped with different mixed precision policies.

methods.name: _validate_frozen_params( root_module: nn.Module, modules_to_wrap: set[nn.Module], ignored_params: set[nn.Parameter], use_orig_params: bool, )
methods.description: Validates that the parameters in modules to be wrapped are either all frozen or all trainable, enforcing FSDP constraints.

methods.name: list[tuple[str,nn.Module]] _get_post_order_named_modules( root_module: nn.Module, )
methods.description: Returns modules in post-order traversal for correct wrapping sequence, ensuring dependencies are correctly handled.

methods.name: dict[nn.Parameter,str] _get_managed_param_to_fqn( module_to_wrap: nn.Module, ignored_params: set[nn.Parameter], visited_modules: set[nn.Module], root_prefix: str, )
methods.description: Creates a mapping from module parameters to their fully qualified names, considering ignored modules and avoiding re-traversal into already visited modules.
